questions.questionText: For a certain reaction, ΔH = 30 kJ/mol and ΔS = 100 J/(K·mol). At what temperature will the reaction become spontaneous, considering ΔH and ΔS are independent of temperature?
questions.explanation: For spontaneity, ΔG = ΔH - TΔS < 0. Hence, T > ΔH / ΔS. Here ΔH = 30000 J/mol and ΔS = 100 J/(K·mol). T > 30000 / 100 = 300 K. Therefore, the reaction is spontaneous when T > 300 K.
